MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge felt related to precise hardware work, which fits my recent machine screws and locking washers, although I have no clearance-measuring task right now.",
    "The steel-reinforced epoxy felt potentially useful for repairing hardware, but that connection is tentative until I have a specific repair."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Cutting wheels and wire brushes assume I am cutting metal or removing rust; buying fasteners does not establish either need or ownership of compatible tools.",
    "Pocket-hole screws serve a different purpose from my metric machine screws, and electrical ring connectors assume a wiring project my purchases do not show.",
    "The COVID test and reaching aid do not address my current fastening or organizing interests, while sealing tape and bulk glue require repair needs I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "Items that attach things seem to have been treated as interchangeable, even though magnetic hooks, machine screws, woodworking screws and adhesives solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point most clearly toward magnetic hanging supplies and small mechanical fasteners, where intended use and compatible sizes matter.",
    "I shop infrequently and need a concrete reason to act; a vaguely useful tool or repair material is not enough, especially in quantities such as ten packs of glue."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad hardware interest but missed my narrower fastening and organizing needs and my reluctance to buy without an immediate use."
}
